achievements.name: Start with a bang!
achievements.description: Defeat QA-1MIL, the last line of defense in Quality Assurance, in Track 1.

achievements.name: Cream of the Crop
achievements.description: Defeat Rekka, the Head of Production, in Track 2.

achievements.name: This will cost you big time
achievements.description: Remove the Head of Development's creative control by defeating them.

achievements.name: The Negotiator
achievements.description: Defeat Korsica, the Head of Security.

achievements.name: Headliner
achievements.description: Defeat the Head of Marketing.

achievements.name: Time to pay up!
achievements.description: Settle the bill with the Head of Finance by defeating them.

achievements.name: Who's the boss now?
achievements.description: Defeat the CEO, Kale Vandelay.

achievements.name: Easy Listening
achievements.description: Finish the game completing every level on the Easy difficulty.

achievements.name: Well that was a rush!
achievements.description: Finish the game and complete every level on the Normal difficulty.

achievements.name: I think I deserve some praise, here!
achievements.description: Finish the game and complete every level on the Hard difficulty.

achievements.name: And the crowd goes wild!
achievements.description: Finish the game and complete every level on the Very Hard difficulty.

achievements.name: Didn't skip a beat!
achievements.description: Finish the game and complete every level on the Rhythm Master difficulty.

achievements.name: Problem solved... wait, what?
achievements.description: Discover the deeper mystery behind the SPECTRA doors scattered across the campus.

achievements.name: I can't see this ever being a problem again
achievements.description: Solve the SPECTRA mystery once and for all in an epic battle.

achievements.name: Thanks for the free chip, Peppermint!
achievements.description: Purchase and equip your first upgrade chip.

achievements.name: Chip-tuned
achievements.description: Increase your chip slots to the maximum capacity.

achievements.name: I play my own way!
achievements.description: Purchase and equip your first Special Attack.

achievements.name: Whoa! There's ANOTHER health bar!?
achievements.description: Increase your health to where you unlock a second tier.

achievements.name: I think that's enough health for now
achievements.description: Fully upgrade your health bar by collecting all Life Gauges.

achievements.name: Fully Powered Up!
achievements.description: Fully upgrade your Reverb Gauge to the maximum.

achievements.name: I have to read these things?
achievements.description: Find and read half of the Vandelay Vlogs on the campus.

achievements.name: I have to read ALL of these things?
achievements.description: Find and read every Vandelay Vlog on the campus.

achievements.name: Feeling the beat!
achievements.description: Land 20 beat-hit attacks on enemies.

achievements.name: Beat-hit mania
achievements.description: Land 500 beat-hit attacks on enemies.

achievements.name: You got this, Peppermint?
achievements.description: Destroy 10 barriers by calling in Peppermint.

achievements.name: You must like calling me in, Chai
achievements.description: Destroy 50 barriers by calling in Peppermint.

achievements.name: Z-shielding's got nothing on us!
achievements.description: Shatter 10 enemy shields by calling in Macaron.

achievements.name: I think I found your calling, Macaron
achievements.description: Shatter 50 enemy shields by calling in Macaron.

achievements.name: Out in a puff of smoke
achievements.description: Put out 10 fires in battle with Korsica.

achievements.name: This is a breeze!
achievements.description: Put out 50 fires in battle with Korsica.

achievements.name: Perfect Parry
achievements.description: Sucessfully parry with perfect timing 15 times.

achievements.name: Perfecter Parry-er!
achievements.description: Sucessfully parry with perfect timing 200 times.

achievements.name: Uh, they were broken when I got here
achievements.description: Destroy 200 Vandelay security robots.

achievements.name: That's a lot of junk metal…
achievements.description: Destroy 500 Vandelay security robots.

achievements.name: OK, well THEY came after ME!
achievements.description: Destroy 1000 Vandelay security robots.

achievements.name: Kissing the sky!
achievements.description: Perform 50 Aerial Raves.

achievements.name: We're Jammin'
achievements.description: Successfully pull off 20 Jam Combos

achievements.name: I'm not done with you yet
achievements.description: Overkill 20 enemies.

achievements.name: First we parry, then we counter
achievements.description: Perform 20 parry counters using any partner.

achievements.name: Now this is how you fight like a team!
achievements.description: Perform 100 parry counters using any partner.

achievements.name: My Ultimate Setlist
achievements.description: Complete all the floors in the Rhythm Tower.

achievements.name: I look cool. But I can look COOLER.
achievements.description: Equip any costume.

achievements.name: What a journey it was...
achievements.description: Complete the Wall of Fame in the hideout.

achievements.name: This was... not what I expected.
achievements.description: Have "The Artist" decorate your hideout.

achievements.name: There's such a thing as TOO helpful
achievements.description: Find and engage with every Smidge, while completing all of his practice tips.

achievements.name: Have we met before?
achievements.description: Find Vandelay HR's investigator and hear all of its monologues.

achievements.name: Who put gears in there?
achievements.description: Destroyed your first golden statue of Kale.

achievements.name: Alright, that felt AWESOME!
achievements.description: Defeated your first enemy with a Rhythm Parry Attack.

achievements.name: I hit things with a guitar really well.
achievements.description: Finish a stage with a S rank for every Chorus. (Any difficulty.)

achievements.name: I'm untouchable!
achievements.description: Finish a stage without taking any damage. (Any difficulty.)

achievements.name: You can pet the cat!
achievements.description: Play with 808 in the hideout.

achievements.name: Wanna hear my playlist?
achievements.description: Change the background music in the hideout.

achievements.name: Does that say weakpoint?
achievements.description: Destroy QA-1MIL's face, revealing its shame.

achievements.name: I told you I'd be fine, Peppermint!
achievements.description: Complete the ride through production on the transit rail without taking damage.

achievements.name: You ever parry a volcano?
achievements.description: Successfully parry a volcanic rock outside of research and development.

achievements.name: I am a good person who likes to help
achievements.description: Help out 3 Vandelay robots with their pressing issues.

achievements.name: I'm trying to FOCUS HERE!
achievements.description: Find and shoot down every hovering announcement drone.

achievements.name: With our powers combined…and to the rhythm…
achievements.description: Perfectly time your take down of your largest foe yet in a musical finale.

achievements.name: I saw all those hits coming a measure away!
achievements.description: Perfectly parry every non-boss enemy's Rhythm Parry attack. (Only for enemies in the main game.)

achievements.name: Check out my moves!
achievements.description: Purchase every combo and partner attack.

achievements.name: OK, I THINK I know what I'm doing now
achievements.description: Successfully pull off every combo and attack in the Training Room.

achievements.name: NOW we got a kickass hideout!
achievements.description: Interact with the arcade machine after completing the main story.

achievements.name: Call me Turbo Chai
achievements.description: Finish a BPM RUSH run without dying, on Easy or Normal difficulty, across all 6 waves.

achievements.name: Choose your own adventure
achievements.description: Complete all 25 floors of the Power Up! Tower Up! mode.

achievements.name: It'll do, CNMN
achievements.description: Unlock the CNMANIAC special attack through arcade points, then use it in combat.

achievements.name: Please don't make this awkward
achievements.description: Obtain the My Hero! special attack via arcade points and deploy it in battle.

achievements.name: That was just EVIL
achievements.description: Clear a run of BPM RUSH in EX Mode (unlocked by earning an S rank on Easy or Normal).

achievements.name: New bad guys? No problem!
achievements.description: Execute perfect rhythm parries against both of the Arcade Update's new enemies, KEM-N0 and DM-ET1L.

achievements.name: It was all for this
achievements.description: Collect the gift basket in the secret room, unlocked after clearing 40 arcade challenges.

achievements.name: Voices from within
achievements.description: Read every developer message scattered throughout the secret room.

achievements.name: Low budget finish
achievements.description: Defeat the final boss while Chai and 808 are both wearing their Low Budget costumes.
